Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds mentioned in document CHEMBL3885881. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure SMILES are available. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3885881. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
